facts.fact: The UNESCO AI observatory profile says the ITU reported 61% of the population of Sao Tome and Principe as using the internet in 2023; no age range is given.
facts.system: ITU share of population using the internet

facts.fact: 54.9 per cent of the population of Sao Tome and Principe used the internet in 2021, an estimate by the International Telecommunication Union.
58.6 per cent of the population of Sao Tome and Principe used the internet in 2022, an estimate by the International Telecommunication Union.
58.7 per cent of the population of Sao Tome and Principe used the internet in 2023, an estimate by the International Telecommunication Union.
59.1 per cent of the population of Sao Tome and Principe used the internet in 2024, an estimate by the International Telecommunication Union.

note: carried from reference/measures.csv; no document opened
The 61% internet penetration is given without source or year or a statement that it is a share of people.

claims.odin-8c9ff6f076: nothing: ODIN scores how openly the statistics office publishes data; no share of people stated

note: ODIN lines score openness of published statistics; none states a share of people using the internet.

claims.wdi-9573ccfccd: nothing: fixed broadband subscriptions, a count of subscriptions the study never uses

note: WDI line gives fixed broadband subscriptions per 100 people, not a share of people using the internet.
Factsheet gives no STP value for individuals using the internet; only regional comparators.
